issue.title: feat(plugins): add llama.cpp integration and widget

repository.name: homarr
repository.description: A modern and easy to use dashboard. 40+ integrations. 20K+ icons built in. Authentication out of the box. No YAML, drag and drop configuration.

issue.body:
**Description**

Adds a first-class llama.cpp (llama-server) integration and a matching widget, so dashboards can monitor any OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp server over its plain HTTP endpoints — no extra sidecar required.

**What it does**

- New integration (`packages/integrations/src/llama-cpp/`): connects to llama-server's built-in endpoints
  - `/health` — liveness
  - `/v1/loads` — model name, context size, KV cache
  - `/metrics` — Prometheus gauges: token generation rate, prompt processing rate, load
  - `/slots` — per-slot KV cache usage and in-flight request state
- New widget (`packages/widgets/src/llama-cpp/`): model name + status, generation speed with a three-tier display (in-request running average → live gauge → process-lifetime average, with tooltip explaining which is shown), context/KV cache usage with optional per-slot breakdown
- API route, request handler, definitions registration and translations (en/zh/cn) wired in
- 21 unit tests for the integration's response mapping, including per-request speed calculation

**Why per-request running average?**

llama-server's `/metrics` rate gauge resets to 0 while idle and reflects a rolling bucket while busy, so a dashboard polling it cannot tell "fast now" from "fast earlier". The widget instead diffs `next_token[0].n_decoded` across polls for the slot's current `id_task` (verified against llama.cpp source, `server-context.cpp`), giving the true average speed since the current request started — matching what the llama.cpp Web UI shows during generation.

**Manual testing performed**

- [x] Integration tested against a real llama-server (b10679-1) running a Qwen 27B GGUF (n_ctx 131072): health, loads, metrics and slots endpoints verified
- [x] Per-request speed verified end-to-end: `id_task` stable during a generation, `n_decoded` increases 0→137 over ~4.4s (~31 t/s), resets on request end
- [x] Widget deployed on a production Homarr instance (Docker, NAS) — KV usage, speed tiers and tooltips render correctly across busy/idle transitions
- [x] `pnpm turbo run build` (3/3), typecheck (4 packages), lint and format all green; 21/21 integration unit tests pass

**Additional context**

None — this is self-contained: it only adds new files plus the standard registration points (definitions, translations, exports).

issue.body:
# Homarr v2 release flight check

This PR is the single release checklist. Add evidence beside each completed gate; validate one frozen candidate, and repeat affected checks when it changes.

**Path:** finish fixes in `release/v2` → merge `release/v2` directly into `dev` → human-approved `dev → main` major release → verify public artifacts.

## Current state · 2026-09-12

- `release/v2`: `2049c6ade`; `dev`: `43a57a2d`; latest stable: **v1.77.1**.
- [Previously validated baseline CI and preview publication](https://github.com/homarr-labs/homarr/actions/runs/34508074005), CodeQL and Workshop passed. This does **not** prove upgrade or browser behavior.
- Release article #6790 and llama.cpp #6765 are merged. #6806 remains excluded. #6810 is closed and is not a release prerequisite; its earlier focused browser results do not establish acceptance of the final release candidate.
- Direct merge path selected: `release/v2 → dev`. The branches currently have 65 dev-only / 606 v2-only commits. Their conflicts are resolved in #6821 (`0501c6f21`), which contains both current branch tips. Land that merge with dev ancestry preserved, then refresh the direct comparison. #6820 targets the old bottom stack and is not a prerequisite for this path.
- #6824 is merged: source setup, production update docs, beta workflow and demo username protection. #6821 now merges current `dev` as well as `release/v2`; refreshed CI is pending. Next.js, Widgets and Translation typechecks and 37 focused tests passed. Dev fixes, translations and exact-build regression-report fields remain for review.
- Check the [dev branch rules](https://github.com/homarr-labs/homarr/rules/687872) against the direct merge PR: the previous audit found a retired `Container and E2E` requirement. Reconcile required checks before landing. Rules on the old `v2` stack branch are not a prerequisite for this path.

## Before release

- [ ] **Integrate and freeze.** Review and land #6821 after CI with its merge ancestry preserved; exclude #6806. Prepare the direct `release/v2 → dev` merge, resolve conflicts, and verify preserved dev fixes. Land the reviewed result in `dev`; record candidate SHA and release owner. The individual stack layers do not need to land first.
- [ ] **Pass release validation.** On that candidate, pass CI/CodeQL, docs/Workshop builds and both image architectures; reconcile required checks; attach a production dependency/image security report and resolve or explicitly accept release-critical findings.
- [ ] **Record data-safety evidence.** Attach the completed v1 → v2 automatic migration checks and database coverage, including representative data and sign-in. Repeat affected cases only if migration changes land. Keep backup/restore and rollback evidence with the release record; users update their image normally.
- [ ] **Check regressions against current dev.** Replay the same desktop/mobile flows and fixtures: login/permissions, boards and drag/resize, widget refresh/failure, integration setup, import/export and backup. Check v2-only Custom Widgets, Workshop, Assistant/MCP and onboarding separately. For each confirmed regression, link one issue with exact builds, reproduction steps, impact and an owner; check for duplicates and verify the same steps after a fix. Revisit open regressions and affected flows as release changes land.
- [ ] **Prepare publication.** Verify production image/Workshop URLs and Helm guidance; coordinate the GA article with artifact availability (docs deploy from `dev`, and the article is already marked `draft: false`); prepare release notes, support and rollback ownership. Confirm Semantic Release selects v2.0.0 and keep the major-release human merge gate.

## Release and follow-through

- [ ] **Release, verify and announce.** Human-merge the approved `dev → main` PR; verify the v2.0.0 release, archives and immutable amd64/arm64 image digests. Smoke a public clean install and v1 upgrade; verify docs, Workshop and downloads; then announce and monitor upgrade/auth/data issues with a named rollback owner.

**Candidate:** pending · **Release / rollback owner:** pending · **Evidence / accepted issues:** pending
